findings.summary: The meshopt packager reimplemented glTF object, index, and string-array readers instead of using the shared gltf-document shape authority. It now reuses asObject, asIndex, asStrings, and JsonRecord while retaining its packaging-specific errors.

Meshopt fallback validation rescanned every bufferView once or twice for every buffer and allocated temporary flatMap arrays. One indexed pass now records parent views and compressed-source references, making the buffer walk linear.

Two meshopt fixtures packaged the same source twice before inspecting and resolving it. Each test now retains one packaged byte array so both assertions exercise the identical artifact without duplicate filesystem and decoder setup work.

PinnedNodeMaterial restated every compiled binding field even though PinnedNodeCompiledBindings is the shared contract used by the receiver, caster, and agreement check. The material compile result now intersects that shared type only with its extra fields.
decompressGeometry checked the meshopt trigger immediately before runPinnedPreParse checked the same trigger. The shared pass now owns the single predicate check.

Generated animation fades duplicated target-kind dispatch in separate getter and setter functions, wrote the unchanged source weight at scheduling, and rewrote the exact destination after clamped interpolation had already written it. One validated float-reference accessor now serves reads and writes, and both no-op writes are gone.

The animation source-shape test asserted arithmetic calculated only in local JavaScript rather than executing emitted C++. Those tautological assertions were removed while the emitted clamp, interpolation, completion erase, replacement order, and behavioral native tests remain.
SDL repeated the morphDeltas and morph name-to-buffer mapping in PBR, node, and Standard storage resolvers. All three now call one inline morph_storage_buffer_for helper.
Node shadow row generation reflected the entire composed WGSL even when the graph declared no shadow bindings. It now returns before reflection for the empty case.
Node-only morph graphs keep BBLITE_GPU_MORPH_STORAGE alive for reflected buffers and consequently compile and bind the generic renderer's morph-storage superset as well.
findings.blockedBy: A second generic-only capability must be threaded through both PALs' mesh, background, and skybox group layouts, but there is no backend-layout test proving node reflected storage survives while generic group 0 stays empty; that coverage and a generic-morph corpus measurement are required before changing the shared define.

findings.summary: SDL bind_stage_storage allocates a vector for every non-empty reflected stage on every draw, including Scene 64's fixed two-buffer node morph pair.
findings.blockedBy: The shared binder also serves shadow stages with a different resource count, and no slot-count test or draw-loop allocation measurement exists to choose safely between an inline pair and a reusable caller-owned scratch buffer.

findings.summary: Pinned node variant generation reflects the same composed WGSL independently for shadow, morph, and environment row collectors.
findings.blockedBy: The collectors currently own distinct validation and diagnostic contracts; a shared reflected-row type plus doctored-variant tests are missing, so consolidating the scans now could weaken drift errors without a test detecting it.
